title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta22

## Documentation and release-candidate cleanup

This prerelease reconciles the public Navimower Map Card documentation and release pipeline with the cumulative 0.3.6 development line through beta21. The visible/runtime feature behavior is intentionally unchanged from beta21 apart from the synchronized beta22 version marker.

### Current 0.3.6 behavior documented

- Document the opt-in Multi mower Site API view, automatic member discovery, member-scoped controls/Schedule/History/zone interaction, merged-notification targeting and prioritized/selective site rendering.
- Document the final underlay architecture: OpenStreetMap, Estonia Ortofoto/Hübriid and authenticated Google Satellite using integration-owned provider reference frames and provider-specific Multi mower site origins.
- Document manual underlay presentation calibration at ±10 m East/North and ±5° rotation without feeding those visual adjustments back into Navimower georeferencing.
- Document phased base/current-cycle loading, Home Assistant-time-zone History selection, bounded request/retry behavior and stale async response rejection.
- Document exact polygon Gate areas and the final visual editor semantics: first three points free, later taps insert into the nearest existing edge with no distance limit, midpoint insertion remains available, crossing edges block Save, and writes use `navimower.set_gate_area` / `navimower.delete_gate_area`.
- Clarify that the Mow dialog sends internal `map.zones[].id` values. First-generation H-series mowers can receive selected zones but retain mower-controlled ordering.

### Documentation cleanup

- Refresh README from the 0.3.5-era feature description to the current 0.3.6 feature set and compatibility boundaries.
- Add `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/MULTI_MOWER_AND_UNDERLAYS.md` and `docs/GATE_AREA_EDITOR.md`.
- Replace the old 0.1.6-era Session API guide with the current phased Map API/current-cycle/History contract.
- Refresh outline documentation to the current uniform 1.5 px defaults, including Custom Areas.
- Bring `CHANGELOG.md` forward with the missing 0.3.5 stable baseline and this cumulative 0.3.6 release-candidate entry.

### Release pipeline cleanup

- Treat the committed cumulative `src/navimower-map-card.js` as the release source of truth.
- Active `prepare-release` now only synchronizes the package/runtime version and builds the deterministic single-file `dist` copy.
- Historical beta `upgrade-*`/preparation scripts remain available for development history and regression fixtures but are no longer replayed to construct every new release.
- Make the beta16/beta18/beta19/beta20/beta21 regression contracts forward-compatible with this cumulative release model.

### Compatibility

- Recommended companion integration: **Navimower 0.4.4-beta36 or newer** for the complete current Map Card 0.3.6 feature set.
- Basic 0.3.5-era Single mower behavior remains compatible with Navimower 0.4.3+, while newer 0.3.6 features retain their documented integration capability boundaries.
- This is still a prerelease. Stable Map Card 0.3.6 and the final stable pairing with Navimower 0.4.4 remain intentionally deferred until this cleaned candidate has had another beta cycle.
